about: A tab's lifecycle hint (ui_model::tabbar::tab_state, core-protocol.md 'Tab bar'): the tab node; `expect` is "ended", "gone" or null (unknown values give no hint). Clients draw hinted tabs dim with the title unchanged. Generated by the Rust model (tests/client_conformance.rs, VQRO_FIXTURE_UPDATE=1) and reviewed.

cases.name: an unknown state is no hint
a non-string state is no hint
